mapper.insert: insert into t_cruise_nonhomologous_warn( warn_id, device_name, device_type_name, device_mete_name, instance_id, device_mete_id, warn_content, warn_time, warn_type, one_cruise_device_name, two_cruise_device_name, three_cruise_device_name, region_name, custom_name, alarm_type )values( #{warnId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deviceName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deviceTypeName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deviceMeteName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{instanceId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deviceMeteId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{warnContent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sysdate(), #{warnType, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{oneCruiseDeviceName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{twoCruiseDeviceName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{threeCruiseDeviceName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{regionName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{customName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{alarmType, jdbcType=INTEGER} )
mapper.select: select a.instance_id as instanceId, a.device_mete_id as deviceMeteId, a.instance_id_one as instanceIdOne, a.instance_id_two as instanceIdTwo, a.one_cruise_device_name as oneCruiseName, a.two_cruise_device_name as twoCruiseName, a.warn_threshold as warnThreshold, a.interval_type as intervalType, a.cruise_type as warnType, e.device_name as deviceName, k.dict_note as deviceTypeName, d.mete_name as deviceMeteName, d.custom_name as customName, f.region_name as regionName, if (a.instance_id_one = #{deviceId},a.instance_id_two,a.instance_id_one) as oldId from t_cruise_nonhomologous_point_instance a LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete d ON d.device_mete_id = a.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_std_device e ON e.device_id = d.device_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business k ON k.dict_code = e.device_type left join t_std_region f on e.up_region_id = f.region_id where a.instance_id_one = #{deviceId} or a.instance_id_two = #{deviceId}

select a.task_id as taskId, a.instance_id as inspectionId, a.result_num as resultValue from u_patrol_data_result a where a.instance_id = #{inspectionId} and a.createtime is not null
and a.createtime between #{startTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and #{endTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and a.cruise_result = 246
order by a.createtime desc
limit 4

select a.task_id as taskId, a.instance_id as inspectionId, a.result_num as resultValue from u_patrol_data_result a where a.instance_id = #{instanceId} and a.createtime is not null and a.cruise_result = 246 order by a.createtime desc limit 1

SELECT DISTINCT a.instance_id AS inspectionId, b.inspection_name AS inspectionName, a.device_mete_id AS deviceMeteId, d.device_name AS deviceName, d.device_type AS deviceType, e.mete_name AS deviceMeteName, d.up_region_name AS regionName, e.custom_name AS customName, c.task_id AS taskId FROM t_cruise_point_instance a LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection b ON a.cruise_id = b.inspection_id LEFT JOIN u_patrol_task_attr c ON c.instance_id = a.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete e on a.device_mete_id = e.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_std_device d ON e.device_id = d.device_id WHERE FIND_IN_SET(b.inspection_code, #{deviceId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) and c.task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select a.triphase_id as triphaseId, a.triphase_name as triphaseName, a.device_mete_id as deviceMeteId, a.device_id as deviceId, a.instance_one_id as instanceOneId, a.instance_one_name as instanceOneName, a.one_cruise_device_name as oneruiseDeviceName, a.instance_two_id as instanceTwoId, a.instance_two_name as instanceTwoName, a.two_cruise_device_name as twoCruiseDeviceName, a.instance_tri_id as instanceTriId, a.instance_tri_name as instanceTriName, a.tri_cruise_device_name as triCruiseDeviceName, a.identify_type as identifyType, a.identify_son_type as identifySonType, a.triphase_type as triphaseType, a.warn_threshold as warnThreshold, a.warn_level as warnLevel, e.device_name as deviceName, k.dict_note as deviceTypeName, d.mete_name as deviceMeteName, d.custom_name as customName, f.region_name as regionName from t_cruise_triphase_rule a LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete d ON d.device_mete_id = a.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_std_device e ON e.device_id = d.device_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business k ON k.dict_code = e.device_type LEFT join t_std_region f on e.up_region_id = f.region_id where a.instance_one_id = #{instanceId} or a.instance_two_id = #{instanceId} or a.instance_tri_id = #{instanceId}
select instance_id_one as one, instance_id_two as two from t_cruise_nonhomologous_point_instance where instance_id = #{instanceId}
select instance_one_id as one, instance_two_id as two, instance_tri_id as three from t_cruise_triphase_rule where triphase_id = #{instanceId}
